spanner_invariants.rule: GoogleSQL dialect and Cloud Spanner Enterprise Edition only for Spanner Graph, FTS, ScaNN Vector Search, Locality Groups, and Managed Autoscaler.
All node and edge tables in CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH have unique element aliases (dual-projected node tables use explicit AS aliases in EDGE TABLES).
All SOURCE KEY / DESTINATION KEY REFERENCES target exact node aliases and match full composite PK arity and exact types.
Graph-wide property type uniqueness: no exposed property name has conflicting SQL types across any node or edge table in the same property graph.
Every SQL view declares explicit SQL SECURITY INVOKER (or DEFINER for parameterized views) and every view-backed graph element declares explicit KEY (...).

Never combine INTERLEAVE IN PARENT T ON DELETE CASCADE with a self-referencing FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES T ON DELETE CASCADE on the same table (use standalone dual-FK for ServiceDependsOnService/AdrSupersedesAdr, or INTERLEAVE IN PARENT + NOT ENFORCED FK for ServiceDependsOnAlgo).

DYNAMIC LABEL tables reside in a dedicated separate property graph (SdlcDynamicGraph) without mixing static node/edge tables, enforce lowercase label & JSON keys via CHECK constraints, and use PROPERTIES ALL COLUMNS EXCEPT (properties).

Vector columns use ARRAY<FLOAT32>(vector_length=>768); ScaNN CREATE VECTOR INDEX and ANN queries include WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL, operate on a single table/node with no general JOIN inside the ANN SELECT block, and never run ANN on edges.

No general ROW_NUMBER() analytic window functions in Cloud Spanner GoogleSQL (use UNNEST(ARRAY(SELECT ... ORDER BY ... LIMIT k)) AS x WITH OFFSET AS rank for RRF); FTS queries run in read-only transactions; Vertex AI CREATE MODEL endpoints target regional asia-southeast1 (never global for gemini-embedding-001).

starter_exercises.objective: Translate 5 Neo4j openCypher queries into valid ISO GQL (MATCH TRAIL cycle safety, FOR instead of UNWIND, SAFE_TO_JSON, RETURN ORDER BY LIMIT, OPTIONAL MATCH WHERE).

Complete 4-tier Path A + Path B parity assertions verifying 68 nodes, 174 explicit rows, 60 dual-projected edges (234 logical), 45 Markdown doc coverage, svc-orders<->svc-notifications cycle, svc-analytics DATA_FEED, svc-auth hub in-degree 10, and legacy AT_RISK consumer.
Complete ServiceCallsApi interleaving, standalone dual-FK ServiceDependsOnService, ChunkCitesApiView (SQL SECURITY INVOKER), and CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH SdlcGraph.
Create reverse covering STORING index (INTERLEAVE IN Apis), CREATE SEARCH INDEX, and ScaNN CREATE VECTOR INDEX with WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL.
Implement nodes-before-edges batched mutations (< 80,000 mutations/commit; 500-row chunks) with --dry-run support.
Implement Markdown chunking, regex entity-mention extraction (api-*, svc-*, ADR-*, REQ-*, team-*), and Vertex AI asia-southeast1 embedding preparation.
Complete FTS query with SdlcSynonymDict + enhance_query => TRUE, Fuzzy N-grams (SEARCH_NGRAMS/SCORE_NGRAMS), and single-table ScaNN APPROX_COSINE_DISTANCE with WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL.
Define ServiceDependsOnAlgo (INTERLEAVE IN PARENT Services + NOT ENFORCED destination FK), table-backed SdlcAlgoGraph, and EXPORT DATA ... CALL PageRank via Data Boost.
Implement server-side RRF (k=60) using UNNEST(ARRAY(...)) WITH OFFSET (never ROW_NUMBER()) fusing FTS and ScaNN ANN ranks.
Complete Hero API blast-radius GraphRAG query using MATCH TRAIL, DATA_FEED separation, governing ADRs, requirements, and Markdown citations.
Create PublicApiCatalogView (SQL SECURITY INVOKER) and least-privilege GRANT statements for sdlc_readonly_role.

Configure Vertex AI regional embeddingModels (gemini-embedding-001 in asia-southeast1 via ADC), OIDC authServices binding @caller_email, curated readOnly spanner-sql tools, and isolated persona toolsets (never databaseRole or spanner-execute-sql).
Bind isolated persona toolsets and verify OIDC authenticated parameter fail-closed behavior against prompt injection.
Customize enterprise nodes/edges/chunks/QPS, Bangkok primary & Singapore DR backup settings, validate via sizing_calculator.py --worksheet, and update todo_status from TODO(Lab 7) to COMPLETED.
Author Spanner Studio RETURN SAFE_TO_JSON(p) blast-radius path visualization query and SPANNER_SYS Query/Lock (microsecond-to-second)/Split-Point introspection queries.
